name: ProjectMind for Anthropic Claude Code
description: Universal local-first project intelligence, MCP server, skills, and settings hooks for Anthropic Claude Code.

capabilities.restartInstructions: Restart Claude Code or run `/mcp` and `/hooks` to confirm active status.
documentedLimitations: When allowManagedHooksOnly is enforced by enterprise policy, Claude Code falls back to .claude/skills/projectmind/SKILL.md and CLAUDE.md.

installationInstructions: Run `projectmind plugin install claude-code` in your project root.
upgradeInstructions: Run `projectmind plugin update claude-code` to refresh configs, skills, and hooks.
removalInstructions: Run `projectmind plugin uninstall claude-code` to cleanly remove integration while preserving project knowledge.
